note: Draft vectors for the contract profile swarma-trust-contract/2 of LIP-0014 and for the checks of a child against its parent that two contracts decide. Keys are published test keys of BIP-340 and never real keys. Grant ids, transaction ids and the checkpoint are placeholders, not objects of any chain. No vector holds a grant, a delegation request or an attestation, and none reads a node. A refused vector holds one defect and names a valid neighbour that differs from it in that defect; a vector marked compound holds two defects, names none and shows which of the two a reader reports.

fields.contract: The document as a string: the UTF-8 octets of the string are the octets of the document, and bytes is their number. The file states no document in hexadecimal.
fields.expected: The outcome for a reader of this revision, for which a right of re-delegation does not list spend (D12): ok, or the code of the first rule that fails.
fields.expected_spend_profile: Present where a vector touches the spend profile: the outcome of the same rules with D12 lifted. No reader admits such a contract before the owners decide that spend is delegable.
fields.member_set: For a valid contract, the number of its members: 11 selects the rules of profile /1, 15 those of profile /2.
fields.derived: For a valid contract: sha256 of the bytes, the v3 scope and budget that LIP-0013 section 2.2 derives, and the booking tag of LIP-0013 section 2.4, the SHA-256 of the bytes followed by the 7 ASCII bytes of booking.
fields.pairs: parent and child are two valid contracts as strings, parent_grant_id is the grant id of the parent as a stated input, and parent_vector names the contract vector that holds the same parent. expected is ok, root, or the first code in the order of the steps V3, V4, V6, V8 and V9 of section 8. A pair of the profile spend-profile is judged with D12 lifted.
fields.rules: Each vector names the rules that it exercises by the labels of the list rules.
